name: Hasegawa Junko
source:
New teacher of arts in the school of the Fujimura sisters, her nickname is 'Pochako' (chubby girl).
Extremely bad at socializing, has the TV and clay as her friends.
A cringe woman that cannot read the atmosphere around her.
Junko does things at her own pace too much, she's already at the mercy of Kenji on their first meeting!?
